THE PORTFOLIO

THREE SPECIALIST ENTITIES · ONE AL AIN ECOSYSTEM

A continuum from early learning to specialist care.

The Group’s institutions meet people at different moments in life. The School supports learners from Kindergarten through Grade 12. The University is preparing a founding cohort in health sciences. The Hospital has served patients since 2012.

Each entity retains its own specialist identity, services, leadership, and official digital destination while belonging to a connected local story.

THE STORY IN FACTS

Distinct identities.
A shared geography.

  1. 2012
    Hospital established

    Ain Al Khaleej Hospital begins serving Al Ain and the wider UAE community.

  2. Today
    Two school pathways

    American and UAE Ministry of Education curricula support a Kindergarten-to-Grade-12 learning journey.

  3. Sep 2026
    University founding cohort

    A private health-sciences university prepares to welcome its first cohort, subject to institutional and regulatory requirements.
